Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You call, and pale ribs close around your companion like the hands of an old guardian.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
An adjacent willing ally before a physical defense.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

A cage of spectral ribs catches the edge of the blow. Grant 1 Boon to the defense; on a Strong defense, the ally may push the adjacent attacker 1 square afterward. The ribs disappear immediately.

Source: design/cards/a-ribcage-for-a-shield.md at 295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf.
